program.name: Back Care Long
program.subject: Back care
program.blurb: Long back-care sessions: strength one day, movement and hip work the next.
program.about: Back care with time to do it all. One day is the big three, curl-ups, side planks and bird dogs, with glutes and the upper back in straight sets; the other is a long movement flow for the spine and hips, then a glute circuit. They alternate. Level II adds reps and Level III slows every rep down.
